48.original: Eager to listen to my harp, are you? For what higher praise could a minstrel ask than to have as an audience the very hero who provides inspiration for his songs!

49.original: Yet I have no fresh compositions I deem fit for a champion's ears. Would that I possessed something more to amuse you...

50.original: Ah! I've been struck by the most wonderful idea! <hex:021A020203>You<hex:021A020103> shall be the author─and the subject─of your own creations!

51.original: Yes! By weaving an epic with your own endeavors, you will find yourself casting a critical eye upon past deeds. Think of such works as muses for future growth!

52.original: 'Tis no difficult thing to pen a poem─the words will come of their own accord, I assure you. Simply envision the scene, and describe the memories in faithful detail.

53.original: Omit naught and add naught, and the truth shall remain. Reciting the finished piece should then serve to bring the past to vivid life in your mind's eye.

54.original: And when you look back upon events with undistracted clarity, what was hidden in chaos may now seem blindingly clear. Especially when things are uncolored by the <cough> <hex:021A020203>embellishments<hex:021A020103> I might bring to the story...

55.original: May the recording of your sagas reward you with inspiration and insight. Oh, and do return sometime and share what you have wrought!

56.original: You now have access to the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Duty Recorder<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, allowing you to document duties for viewing within an inn room.

57.original: Open the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Duty Recorder<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> interface located under <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Duty<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> in the main menu, and view the help text for further details on how to use this feature.
